title: Personal Agent client metadata document
description: The document at a Personal Agent's client_id URL. Spec section 4.1 (Agent identity). client_id must equal the URL it was fetched from, and jwks_uri and each redirect_uris entry other than a loopback redirect URI must be on the same domain as client_id; those depend on the fetch and are checked separately. Unknown fields are allowed.

poppy.description: Optional. The protocol and extension versions every install of the Personal Agent implements: one protocol entry per set of compatible versions. Each request still declares its versions in Poppy-Version and Poppy-Extensions.

loopback_url.description: A loopback redirect URI for an app on the User's computer, RFC 8252 section 7.3.
